extension.summary: Unified streaming tracker — sync watch history across 12+ services
extension.description: StreamSyncr is a self-hosted Stremio addon and streaming tracker. Browse catalogs from Trakt, TMDB, IMDb, WeTrakr, AniList, Simkl, MDBList, and more. Resolve streams from Real-Debrid, TorBox, and AllDebrid. Sync your watch history across all connected services.
extension.disclaimer: Self-hosted. Requires a running StreamSyncr backend instance.
